shortDescription: The Product Detail section serves as the main container for product detail pages. It orchestrates three key areas: the media gallery showcasing product images with optional lightbox, the Buy Box containing all purchase-related blocks, and the product details area for descriptions and specifications. Media format adapts between mobile and desktop breakpoints. The section handles data source configuration and offers layout customization through style, background, and spacing options.
